deadline.value: The department gives December 15th with no year, so no date is recorded.
deadline.quote: December 15th for full consideration into PhD, MS Plan A (thesis), and MS Plan B (non-thesis).

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies, and the department says the GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to check faculty research and name the professors they would like to work with.
supervisor.quote: Students seeking admission into our PhD program are strongly recommended to check current faculty research activities and identify faculty of interest.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships and stipends are offered, but the department says the offers are competitive.
funding.quote: Financial aid offers are competitive and based on the availability of funding each year.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's is expected. Students with an approved master's need 18 hours of coursework instead of 36.
entry_route.quote: For students entering with an approved Master’s degree, completion of at least 18 semester hours of course work is required.

also.quote: Students entering with a Bachelor’s degree will satisfactorily complete a minimum of 36 credit hours

notes: The department's $85 fee and TOEFL 5.0 or 90 / IELTS 7.0 rules match the School rules, so they are inherited. Doctoral rules PDF listed on the PhD page was not fetched.
